content.text: Where can I stake my SUI tokens?
Plenty of options! Try official staking via Sui’s network validators or explore DeFi platforms offering boosted rewards. Just watch the lock-up terms and always read the fine print!
Is yield farming on Sui safe?

Higher yields can mean higher risk. With Sui’s low fees, it’s easier to move in or out quickly, but impermanent loss is real. I’m here to guide, not guarantee. Always manage your exposure responsibly.
